kind: build + offline tests (ratification fix rounds 1 and 2 applied)

claude plugin validate ..note: does not check hook event names

versions.jev_server: fake stdio server (private/jev-control/test/fixtures/fake-control-server.mjs); no real Jev server was used

fix_round_1.audit: coverage is bound to concrete grants (plan item action hashes, search hits, bound approvals); no generic slots; order, request, agent context and reuse are checked; tokens are unknown when a field is missing in some messages
fix_round_1.search: find, rerank and the tie-break draw from one budget of 2 evaluations per search id, reserved atomically; tie_unresolved returns only resolved_hits; real attempts reported; raw scores
fix_round_1.actions_and_receipts: options carry an action descriptor and preconditions; plan items carry the raw score and the action hash; receipts carry full provenance and authorize exactly the planned action once
fix_round_1.compaction: plan and scores are paged with explicit markers (plan_next, scores_next) and `cli.mjs page`; scores stay raw
fix_round_1.contracts: tools/list schemas are validated field by field against the published schema (types, required, limits, auto_accept); results are checked for association and consistency; verified against the real server's tools/list
fix_round_1.identity_and_lifecycle: a per-session capability injected by the hook replaces the repository-wide binding; startup/resume/clear/fork and SessionEnd switch the mode off; SessionEnd is registered in hooks/hooks.json
fix_round_1.runner: one campaign-wide exclusive lock taken before spawn; the no-progress stop is removed
fix_round_1.left_for_R02: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in the Bash tool; raw slash text in the prompt hook and the capability line reaching the model; the model copying the capability into subagent prompts; agent_id in subagent payloads; SessionEnd firing; /jev:jev-control in claude -p; --plugin-dir with an installed jev plugin

fix_round_2.actions: the descriptor is tool, exact target and the canonical arguments per tool (Write content, Edit old/new string, Read offset/limit, Agent model and prompt, Grep scope, ...); payloads are bound by SHA-256; a missing required argument or an unknown name is refused; Jev sees the sanitized concrete variant; receipt verify takes the whole action
fix_round_2.receipts: before the first use any move of the tree invalidates; later steps need the evidence paths they depend on unchanged (fingerprinted at decision time) and a step that names none is refused as stale
fix_round_2.audit: refused receipts revoke grants; search grants keep range, hash and rank; only a genuine helper invocation with a plausible output grants; every done attempt replaces the finalization state and an edit after acceptance invalidates it; Incomplete: is told apart from a declared completion; a budget raise needs the user's words in the request; reservations are bound to the agent context
fix_round_2.commit_trailer: first fix commit message amended to Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (tree unchanged)
